_comment: TASK-281 bounded pilot. Documents the shape produced by `MAP_System/scripts/run_manifest.py show <run_id>`. Manifests live in the run_manifests/run_manifest_skills/run_manifest_context_refs SQLite tables (migration/run_manifest_schema.sql); this file is documentation, not a canonical source.

schema.run_id: string, primary key, format RUN-<task_id>-<NN> (per-task sequence)
schema.task_revision: sha256 hex of the task's stable definition fields (title, description, task_type, role, sorted dependencies/output_paths/acceptance_criteria) at manifest-creation time; excludes lifecycle fields (status, owner, claimed_by, lease, attempt) so claim/heartbeat churn never manufactures false staleness
schema.worker_id: string, references agents.agent_id; the accountable execution identity for this run
schema.session_id: string or null; live session identity if available
schema.role_id: string; normalized role (see workflow/role_registry.yaml), never a raw free-form role string
schema.writable_scope: array of repo-relative paths this run may write; defaults to the task's registered output_paths when not explicitly supplied
schema.runtime_limits: object with optional max_attempts, max_tool_failures, runtime_seconds keys; only keys explicitly supplied at creation are present
schema.base_revision: string or null; a Git commit sha for Git-backed work, or null for document-only/non-Git work -- never a placeholder commit
schema.created_by: string, references agents.agent_id; who invoked run_manifest.py create (may differ from worker_id)
schema.skills: array of selected skill names, sorted
schema.context_refs: array of {path, sha256}; the repo-relative path and content hash of each context input at manifest-creation time -- never the copied content itself
